h1: Custom Gray Shirts for Teams & Events
metaDescription: Order custom gray shirts for your team or event. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Gray shirts are a versatile choice for corporate teams, trade shows, and employee uniforms. Unlike basic white or black, gray offers a neutral backdrop that makes your logo stand out without the harsh contrast. Options like heather gray or charcoal work well with screen printing, embroidery, or heat transfer. Whether you need performance polos for a safety crew or soft cotton tees for a company picnic, custom gray shirts deliver a polished, professional look that fits any setting.
